values.note: $15/night from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day.

values.note: 'Typically open the Friday before Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day' (Seasons of Use: 'Memorial Day through September'). Also open in the shoulder seasons, typically without water or garbage service; the access road may be muddy or have patchy snow in spring and fall.

values.note: ADA-accessible toilets, water and garbage containers in season; tent pads at most sites; day-use picnic areas.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/lowland-campground-and-picnic-area ('the toilets are ADA accessible, and water is available along with garbage containers'; Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Butte RD) campground ~20 mi N of Butte: I-15 Elk Park exit 138, ~6 mi W on Lowland Creek Rd (FR 442), then ~1.5 mi on FR 9485; the gravel road is suitable for passenger vehicles. Near Sheepshead Recreation Area / Maney Lake and the Continental Divide Trail. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated August 28, 2026) confirms $15/night, FCFS, 11 back-in sites for trailers to 22 ft, vault toilets, potable water. Added 16-day limit, season (Friday before Memorial Day to Labor Day, shoulder seasons without services; no fixed dates recorded) and the in-season fee window. Hookups (derived none) left. No Beaverhead-Deerlodge alert for the campground or Lowland Creek Rd. Note trimmed of restated sites, length, hookups, facilities and FCFS.
